item.title: Language barriers may limit standard headache treatment access for new mothers after epidurals
item.description: New mothers with limited English proficiency are less likely to receive standard treatment for painful, debilitating headaches that can occur after epidurals.

item.title: Pharmacogenomic testing coverage depends on insurer
item.description: Two patients in the same clinic with the same diagnosis, being considered for the same medication and with the same clinical profile may face different coverage decisions.

item.title: Continuous glucose monitors help type 2 diabetes patients gain five more hours daily in healthy blood sugar range
item.description: Continuous glucose monitors could transform diabetes management for millions of Americans with type 2 diabetes who do not take insulin, according to research.
